name: Komodo Periphery
description: Install the native Komodo Periphery agent in an existing Debian/Ubuntu Docker LXC or VM to manage its containers and Compose stacks through an existing Komodo Core.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_core_address
app_vars.label: Komodo Core URL
app_vars.help: Reachable HTTP or HTTPS Core URL, such as https://komodo.example.com.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_server_name
app_vars.label: Komodo Server Name
app_vars.help: Server name in Core; defaults to the guest hostname.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_onboarding_key
app_vars.label: Server Onboarding Key
app_vars.help: Create a Server Onboarding Key in Komodo Core before installation.

app_vars.name: var_komodo_core_public_key
app_vars.label: Core Public Key
app_vars.help: Optional Core public key; defaults to trusting and pinning the first Core in /etc/komodo/keys/core.pub.

notes.text: Run as root inside an existing Debian/Ubuntu LXC or VM running systemd, not in the Proxmox VE host shell. Existing Docker/Compose is reused. Install Docker/Compose first for unattended runs; interactive runs can offer to install Docker when missing.
Create an onboarding key in Komodo Core before installation, then confirm the server is connected.
Update the agent inside the guest with update_komodo_periphery. Agent updates preserve configuration, keys and deployed stacks without upgrading Docker.
